title: fix(app-shell): a tab hidden for 10 minutes stops polling the shared feeds (objectui#12439)
body:
Fixes #12439
Clause-②: no

## What changed

A tab hidden continuously for 10 minutes stops polling the shared user feeds. Coming back to it refetches each feed once and resumes the foreground cadence.

- **New `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/hiddenTabPollStop.ts`** holds the one clock: `HIDDEN_POLL_STOP_MS` (10 minutes, a constant), `hiddenForMs()` and `isPollingSuspended()`. It reads `document.hidden` at call time and keeps one `visibilitychange` listener, so a hide, show, hide sequence between two polls still restarts the clock. It is not exported from the package entry, so no new public symbol is added (Clause-② stays `no`).
- **`sharedUserFeeds.ts`**: `SharedFeed.schedule()` arms nothing while `isPollingSuspended()` is true, and a tick that comes due after the cut-off sends nothing and re-arms nothing. That covers both the poll tick and the retired-feed probe tick. The existing `onVisibilityChange` refetch (the objectui#4225 behaviour) is unchanged and is now the only way out of the suspension. Its `finally` re-arms at the foreground cadence. `__resetSharedUserFeeds()` also resets the clock.
- **Module headers**: `sharedUserFeeds.ts` gets a new section on the hidden-tab stop and why it exists (scale-to-zero backends), plus notes on `HIDDEN_POLL_MS` and `onVisibilityChange`. `useInboxArrivalNotifier.ts` now states the accepted cost: after 10 minutes hidden, no desktop notification until the user returns, when the message arrives as the in-page toast and bell badge.
- `.changeset/12439-hidden-poll-stop.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

## Premise check (PM assumption A1)

`git grep -lE 'document\.hidden|visibilityState|visibilitychange' -- packages/ apps/` found these source files: `sharedUserFeeds.ts`, `useAiUsage.ts` (refetch on event or visibility, no timer), `useInboxArrivalNotifier.ts` (chooses toast or desktop notification, no timer) and `apps/console/src/inbox-arrival-preview.tsx` (preview, no timer). So `sharedUserFeeds.ts` is the only timer poller that reads visibility, and A1 holds. Every `setInterval` in `packages/*/src` and `apps/*/src` was also listed. None is a visibility-reading network poller (see Acceptance notes for the one network poller that ignores visibility).

## Tests

New pins:
- `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/sharedUserFeeds.hiddenStop-12439.test.tsx`: counts approvals `fetch` calls and `sys_inbox_message` finds under fake timers with a `document.hidden` driver. Cases:
  - below the cut-off, the 60 s hidden cadence is unchanged (mount read plus 9 ticks);
  - after the cut-off, no requests across another hour, and `vi.getTimerCount()` is 0;
  - return after the stop gives exactly +1 per feed, then one minute at foreground cadence (+2 approvals, +6 inbox);
  - hide, show for 1 s, hide again restarts the 10-minute clock;
  - with the shared module forced to say "suspended" on a visible tab, both feeds stop polling, so the feeds read the shared helper rather than a copy.
- `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/hiddenTabPollStop-12439.test.tsx`: the clock alone (the threshold edge, already-hidden-at-first-question, a visible spell nobody polled through, the instant release on visible).

Runs, from the repo root, under the shared verify lock, at head `d7a0d5845`:
- the two new files plus `sharedInboxFeed.cadence-7249.test.tsx`: `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 14 passed (14)`
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/hooks/`: `Test Files 64 passed (64)`, `Tests 536 passed (536)`
- the 13 feed-consumer test files outside `hooks/` (every test that names `sharedUserFeeds`, the shared feed hooks, `useInboxBell` or `useHomeInbox`): `Test Files 13 passed (13)`, `Tests 117 passed (117)`
- the full `packages/app-shell/` run hit the 10-minute foreground cap (exit 124, no verdict line), so it is **NOT MEASURED locally and left to CI**.
- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build` exit 0, then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exit 0. That runs `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, whose `include` is `src/**/*.test.ts` and `src/**/*.test.tsx`, so both new test files are type-checked.

**Ablation (one-off, implementation committed first):** in `sharedUserFeeds.ts` the helper import was replaced with a local `isPollingSuspended` stub that always returns `false` using `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `4df0de315421` to `cf3189e7ca51`). Result: 3 failed of 9. The stop case went red (`expected { approvals: 70, inbox: 70 } to deeply equal { approvals: 10, inbox: 10 }`), as did the restart case and the shared-helper case. The return case and all cadence-7249 cases stayed green, which is expected: the return path is the pre-existing visibility handler. Restore: blob equals HEAD (`4df0de315421`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Gates (exit codes)

- lint, narrowed: `eslint --format json` over the 5 changed source and test files under the root `eslint.config.js` gives 5 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, and no file is ignored. The config has no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot change the verdict on any untouched file. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI.
- `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`: all exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs` and `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0.
- `check:spec-floors`: exit 1, `no-artifact` (it needs a whole-workspace build). Known red on main (objectui#12334), recorded and not touched.

## Acceptance notes

- **Probes are gated too.** A retired feed's re-probe timer obeys the same stop. Probes are already capped at 3 per page, and on return `onVisibilityChange` re-probes under the existing `mayProbe` gate. A skipped probe tick implies at least `UNAVAILABLE_PROBE_MS` has passed since `retiredAt`, so the return path is never locked out.
- **Not in scope, noted rather than filed:** `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/useDashboardAutoRefresh.ts` runs a `setInterval` at the authored `refreshIntervalSeconds` and ignores tab visibility. So a dashboard that opts into auto-refresh, left open in a hidden tab, keeps polling too. It reads no visibility, so it is outside this card's scope ("pollers that read `document.hidden`"), and it is author-opted. Owner: none.
- Return after the stop: each polled feed (approvals, inbox) sends one request. The activity feed is not polled (`pollMs` 0) and binds no visibility handler, so it is unchanged.
